name: sds-poc
description: Docker Container Intelligence POC using Niriksha AI — HTTP & gRPC

scripts.bundle: npm run build && ncc build dist/index.js -o bundle --minify && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('README.md','bundle/README.md')"
scripts.package:linux: npm run bundle && pkg bundle/index.js --target node18-linux-x64 --output release/sds-poc-linux
scripts.package:win: npm run bundle && pkg bundle/index.js --target node18-win-x64 --output release/sds-poc-win.exe
scripts.package:all: npm run bundle && pkg bundle/index.js --targets node18-linux-x64,node18-win-x64 --output release/sds-poc
